vi: Dự án đầu tư xây dựng
dn: A set of proposals involving the use of capital to build new, upgrade, expand, repair, renovate or relocate works in order to maintain, develop or improve the quality of the works or of products and services. Per Clause 6, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.
A product built according to a design, created by human labor, construction materials and equipment installed in the work, and fixed to the land. Per Clause 2, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.

Includes preparing, verifying, appraising and approving projects and construction designs; surveys; construction permitting; construction and construction supervision; project management; and other related activities. Per Clause 1, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.

An individual, or the representative of an agency, organization or enterprise, with the authority to approve a project and decide on construction investment. Per Clause 5, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.

In bidding: the agency or organization that owns the capital, borrows the capital, or is directly assigned to manage and use the capital and to manage the project implementation process. Per Clause 2, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023 (definition for bidding purposes).
Planning, organizing, coordinating and controlling resources so that a project achieves its objectives for scope, quality, cost, schedule and safety.
An organization established by the investor or a competent authority to carry out construction investment project management tasks.

vi: Tư vấn quản lý dự án
dn: A consulting organization hired by the investor to carry out part or all of the project management work under a contract.

vi: Giám đốc quản lý dự án
dn: The title of an individual assigned by the director of the project management unit, the representative of the project management consulting organization, or the investor to manage and coordinate project management. Per Clause 6, Article 3 Decree 212/2026/ND-CP.
Individuals and organizations that can affect, or be affected by, the project: the investor, contractors, consultants, regulators, surrounding residents, users of the work, etc.
All the work that must be performed to deliver the product of the project or bid package; the basis for controlling changes, costs and schedule.

vi: Cơ cấu phân chia công việc
dn: A diagram that breaks the project scope down into work packages that can be assigned, measured and controlled.
The approved version of the plan (scope, schedule, cost), used as a benchmark for comparing performance and assessing changes.
A formal request to change the scope, design, schedule or cost; its impact must be assessed and it must be approved before implementation.
The process of receiving, assessing, approving and tracking changes so as to avoid uncontrolled variations.

vi: Ma trận phân công trách nhiệm
dn: A table that identifies who performs, who is ultimately accountable, who is consulted and who must be informed for each task.
The first meeting among the parties to agree on objectives, scope, organization, communication channels, coordination procedures and the overall plan.
A record of what went well and what did not in a project, to be applied to later projects.
A list of identified risks, with their levels, responsible persons and response measures.
A list of issues currently arising that need to be handled, with the responsible person and the deadline for resolution.
A document recording the contents, decisions and action items after a meeting; the basis for follow-up and for resolving later disputes.
Weekly and monthly reports on the project's quantities, schedule, quality, safety, cost and outstanding issues.
The successive stages of a project: preparation, implementation, and completion of construction to put the work into operation and use.
A document approving the launch of a project, stating the objectives, preliminary scope, project manager and the authority delegated.

vi: Kỹ sư khối lượng – chi phí
dn: The person responsible for measuring quantities, preparing cost estimates, controlling costs, and handling payment and final settlement of contracts.
The entire construction investment cost of a project as determined in the feasibility study report; it is the cost limit when implementing the project.
The cost needed to build a work, bid package or task, determined on the basis of quantities, design and appropriate unit prices.
A table listing the tasks, units of measurement and quantities; used for cost estimating, tendering, pricing and payment.
Determining the quantities of work from design drawings and technical specifications according to uniform measurement rules.
The cost per unit quantity of work, including materials, labor, construction machinery and related costs.
The amount of materials, labor and construction machinery required to complete one unit quantity of construction work.
An indicator reflecting the movement of construction prices over time; used to determine and adjust the total investment, cost estimates and contract prices.
A cost provision for quantities arising and for price escalation during project implementation.
Costs of managing and running production at the site, plus a portion of the enterprise's costs allocated to construction costs.
Costs not directly tied to a specific task, such as temporary buildings, safety, machinery mobilization and site preparation work.
The cost of materials, labor and construction machinery that directly make up the quantity of work.
Allocating the project budget by work item and stage to control costs from the design phase onward.
Tracking and comparing actual costs against the plan, issuing warnings and proposing corrective action when deviations occur.

vi: Quản lý giá trị thu được
dn: A method of assessing schedule and cost together by comparing planned value, earned value and actual cost.
The planned and actual receipts and payments of the project over time; used to arrange funds and make payments on time.
Reviewing design and construction solutions to reduce costs while keeping the required functionality and quality.

vi: Thanh toán theo đợt (tạm thanh toán)
dn: A payment for completed quantities in each stage or each month, as agreed in the contract.
A document certifying the value to be paid in a given payment period after quantities have been checked and deductions made.
A portion of the payment value withheld by the employer under the contract to ensure the contractor fulfills its obligations, usually tied to the warranty.
Determining the final total value of the contract that the employer is responsible for paying the contractor upon completion of the works.

vi: Quyết toán vốn đầu tư dự án
dn: Fully and accurately determining the investment capital actually spent on a completed project; mandatory for projects using state capital.
Adjusting unit prices or the contract price when the prices of materials, labor and machinery fluctuate, under the conditions agreed.
Minor work paid for according to the labor time, materials and machinery actually used rather than at unit prices for quantities.
An amount provisionally allowed for work that was not fully defined when the contract was signed; it will be re-determined during implementation.
A civil contract between the employer and the contractor to carry out part or all of the work in construction investment activities.

The organization or individual that enters into a construction contract with the contractor to carry out part or all of the work in construction activities. Per Clause 1, Article 3 Decree 210/2026/ND-CP.

The organization, individual, or association of organizations and individuals that enters into a contract with the employer to carry out part or all of the work in construction activities. Per Clause 2, Article 3 Decree 210/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Điều kiện chung của hợp đồng
dn: The part that sets out the basic rights, obligations and relationship of the parties in a construction contract. Per Clause 3, Article 3 Decree 210/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Điều kiện cụ thể của hợp đồng
dn: The part that specifies, supplements or amends the general conditions to suit each particular contract. Per Clause 4, Article 3 Decree 210/2026/ND-CP.
A document attached to the contract to specify in detail, clarify, amend or supplement certain provisions. Per Clause 5, Article 3 Decree 210/2026/ND-CP.
A contract with a price that is fixed throughout implementation for the quantities of work within the scope of the signed contract.

vi: Hợp đồng theo đơn giá cố định
dn: A contract paid according to the actual accepted quantities multiplied by fixed unit prices that do not change throughout the implementation period.

vi: Hợp đồng theo đơn giá điều chỉnh
dn: A contract whose unit prices are adjusted according to price escalation agreements; paid according to actual accepted quantities.

vi: Hợp đồng đo đạc lại khối lượng
dn: A contract in which quantities are re-measured according to actual construction for payment, usually combined with the unit price form.

vi: Hợp đồng theo chi phí cộng phí
dn: A contract paying the reasonable actual costs plus a fee to the contractor.

vi: Hợp đồng thiết kế – cung cấp thiết bị – thi công
dn: A contract under which one contractor (the general contractor) carries out the design, procurement of materials and equipment, and construction of the work.

vi: Hợp đồng thiết kế và thi công
dn: A contract assigned to one contractor to carry out both the design and the construction of the work.

vi: Hợp đồng chìa khóa trao tay
dn: A contract under which the contractor carries out all the work from preparing the project and design to supplying equipment, construction, and testing and commissioning, handing over the work ready for operation.
An amount the employer pays to the contractor in advance to mobilize the work, recovered gradually through successive payments.
A commitment by a bank or credit institution to guarantee repayment of the advance payment if the contractor fails to perform properly.

vi: Bảo đảm thực hiện hợp đồng
dn: A measure (usually a bank guarantee) to ensure that the contractor properly performs its contractual obligations.
A guarantee that replaces the retention money to secure the obligation to provide the warranty for the work.

vi: Thay đổi, phát sinh / lệnh thay đổi
dn: A change in quantities, design or implementation conditions compared with the signed contract; it must be confirmed in writing before being carried out.

vi: Khối lượng, công việc phát sinh hợp lý
dn: Quantities or work outside the scope of the contract that must be adjusted or added during implementation and are agreed by the parties. Per Clause 8, Article 3 Decree 210/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Bồi thường do chậm tiến độ (thỏa thuận trước)
dn: An amount agreed in advance in the contract that the party in breach must pay for late completion; penalty and compensation levels must comply with the applicable law.
An amount the party in breach must pay under the contract when it fails to perform its obligations properly.

vi: Khiếu nại, yêu cầu bồi thường theo hợp đồng
dn: A party's request for additional time or cost, with supporting grounds, sent to the other party following the procedures and deadlines in the contract.

vi: Gia hạn thời gian thực hiện
dn: Extending the contract completion period for reasons accepted by the contract.
An event that occurs objectively, cannot be foreseen and cannot be remedied despite all necessary measures having been applied.

vi: Tạm dừng thực hiện hợp đồng
dn: A party's suspension of work in the cases and according to the procedures permitted by the contract and the law.
Ending a contract before its term in the cases agreed or provided for by law.
The procedure confirming that the parties have completed or terminated their contractual obligations and the contractual relationship has ended.
The party appointed by the employer under a FIDIC contract to administer the contract, certify payments and make decisions within the authority delegated.
A board of experts established by agreement of the parties to consider and make decisions on contract disputes before they go to arbitration or court.
Calendar days, excluding Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays as prescribed by law. Per Clause 6, Article 3 Decree 210/2026/ND-CP.

The process of selecting a contractor to sign and perform a consulting, non-consulting, goods procurement or construction contract; or selecting an investor to sign and perform a business investment project contract. Per Clause 8, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.

The agency or organization that carries out bidding activities (the investor or an organization selected by the investor, etc., in the cases listed by the law). Per Clause 1, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.

Part or all of a project or procurement estimate; it may include similar procurement items from several projects or a one-off procurement quantity for a given period. Per Clause 15, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.
A bid package covering design and supply of goods (EP), design and construction (EC), supply of goods and construction (PC), EPC, turnkey, etc. Per Clause 16, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.
The work in the process of constructing and installing a work or work item. Per Clause 33, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.

One or more service activities such as preparing and evaluating planning reports; surveys; preparing pre-feasibility study reports and investment policy proposal reports; and other consulting activities listed by the law. Per Clause 4, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.

Services other than consulting, such as logistics, insurance, advertising, acceptance testing and commissioning, satellite imaging, printing, cleaning, communications, repair and maintenance. Per Clause 5, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.

The complete set of documents used for open bidding, limited bidding and competitive quotation, including the requirements that serve as the basis for contractors to prepare bids and for the procuring entity to evaluate them. Per Clause 21, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.

The complete set of documents used for direct appointment, direct procurement and price negotiation, serving as the basis for contractors to prepare proposals. Per Clause 22, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.

vi: Hồ sơ dự thầu, hồ sơ đề xuất
dn: The complete set of documents prepared by a contractor or investor and submitted to the procuring entity in accordance with the requirements of the bidding documents or request for proposals. Per Clause 23, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.

vi: Hồ sơ mời quan tâm, hồ sơ mời sơ tuyển
dn: The complete set of documents used for open bidding with an expression-of-interest or prequalification step, including capability and experience requirements for selecting a list of contractors. Per Clause 19, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.

The list of contractors that pass prequalification (open bidding with prequalification), the list invited to bid (limited bidding), or the list of contractors whose expressions of interest meet the requirements. Per Clause 3, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.

The price quoted by the contractor in the bid form, including all costs of performing the bid package in accordance with the bidding documents or request for proposals. Per Clause 12, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.
The bid price of the contractor recommended for award after correcting errors, adjusting deviations and deducting any discount. Per Clause 13, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.
The value stated in the contract between the investor and the contractor. Per Clause 14, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.
The time at which the deadline for receiving expressions of interest, prequalification applications, bids or proposals expires. Per Clause 31, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.

vi: Thời gian có hiệu lực của hồ sơ dự thầu
dn: The number of days specified in the bidding documents or request for proposals, counted from the bid closing time to the last day on which the bid remains valid. Per Clause 32, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.
A measure taken by the contractor (deposit, escrow, guarantee) to secure its responsibility for bidding within a specified period.
Carrying out bidding activities on the National Bidding Network System. Per Clause 9, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.
A form of contractor selection with no limit on the number of contractors that may participate.
A form of contractor selection in which a single contractor that meets the requirements is selected directly, in the cases permitted by law.

A subcontractor performing important work of the bid package, proposed by the main contractor in its bid on the basis of the requirements stated in the bidding documents. Per Clause 28, Article 4 Bidding Law 2023.
A design that expresses the ideas for the construction design of the work, the technological line and the equipment. Per Clause 10, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.
A design that expresses the main technical parameters in accordance with the applicable technical regulations and standards. Per Clause 11, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.

A design that fully expresses the solutions, technical parameters and materials used in accordance with the applicable technical regulations and standards. Per Clause 13, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.

vi: Thiết kế bản vẽ thi công
dn: A design that fully expresses the technical parameters, materials and construction details, ensuring the conditions are sufficient to proceed with construction of the work. Per Clause 14, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.

vi: Báo cáo nghiên cứu khả thi
dn: A document presenting the study of the necessity, feasibility and effectiveness of the construction investment project according to the selected basic design option.

vi: Báo cáo nghiên cứu tiền khả thi
dn: A document presenting a preliminary study of the necessity, feasibility and effectiveness of the project, serving as the basis for considering the investment policy.

The verification, assessment and conclusion by an organization or individual on the professional contents needed during project preparation and implementation, as required. Per Clause 15, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.

The review and assessment by the investment decision-maker, the investor, the specialized construction agency or the appraisal council of the contents needed as the basis for consideration and approval. Per Clause 16, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.
A document issued by a competent authority to the investor for building new, repairing, renovating or relocating a work. Per Clause 21, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.
A document specifying technical requirements for materials, construction and acceptance of the work; the basis for construction and quality inspection.

vi: Bản vẽ chi tiết thi công (shop drawing)
dn: Drawings prepared by the contractor to detail the design drawings to suit actual construction conditions, submitted to the consultant for approval before work begins.
Drawings of the completed construction work, showing the location, dimensions, materials and equipment actually used. Per Clause 3, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.
A document describing the sequence, methods, machinery, labor and safety measures for carrying out a specific task.

vi: Yêu cầu làm rõ thông tin
dn: A document the contractor sends to the consultant or investor to ask questions or seek clarification of the design or technical requirements.
Documents the contractor submits for approval: material samples, shop drawings, method statements, equipment catalogues, etc.
A slip accompanying documents sent between the parties, listing the items, number of copies and purpose of sending, for tracking.
Uniformly coding, issuing, storing, updating versions of and distributing project documents.
A revision of a drawing or document, marked with a symbol so that it is clear which version is currently in force.
A document stating the requirements, objectives, scale, functions and applicable standards for carrying out the design.
Drilling, excavation and testing to determine ground and groundwater conditions for foundation and structural design.
Measuring the existing site conditions, levels and existing works for project preparation and design.

vi: Chứng chỉ hành nghề hoạt động xây dựng
dn: A certificate of practice capability issued to individuals in the cases under Clause 1, Article 88 of the Construction Law 2025, who have sufficient professional qualifications and experience. Per Clause 1, Article 3 Decree 212/2026/ND-CP.

The title of an individual assigned by an organization to manage and coordinate all consulting work involving different specialties (survey lead, design lead, etc.). Per Clause 2, Article 3 Decree 212/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Hồ sơ hoàn thành công trình
dn: The set of records and documents related to the construction investment process of a work that must be kept when the work is put into operation and use. Per Clause 4, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.
A system of procedures and plans to prevent errors and ensure that the product meets requirements from the start.
Inspecting and testing products and work to detect and correct deviations from the requirements.

vi: Quản lý chất lượng công trình xây dựng
dn: Management activities of the parties involved in preparing and implementing construction investment and in operating and using the work, to ensure quality and safety requirements. Per Clause 1, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Kế hoạch quản lý chất lượng
dn: A document setting out the organization, responsibilities, and inspection and acceptance procedures applied to a project or bid package.

vi: Kế hoạch kiểm tra và thí nghiệm
dn: A table listing the inspection and testing steps, acceptance stop points, acceptance criteria and the person responsible for each task.
A point in the ITP at which the contractor must stop and wait for acceptance (hold point) or must invite the supervisor to witness (witness point) before continuing.
A document the contractor sends to the supervisor or investor requesting inspection and acceptance of completed work.
The procedure for submitting samples, certificates and material specifications for the investor or consultant to approve before use in the work.

vi: Nghiệm thu vật liệu đầu vào
dn: Checking the type, certificates and test results of materials, products and equipment before they are used in the work.

vi: Báo cáo sự không phù hợp
dn: A document recording work or materials that do not meet requirements, with requirements for rectification and re-inspection.
A measure to eliminate the cause of a nonconformity so that it does not recur.
A document from the supervision consultant or investor requiring the contractor to carry out or adjust work on site.
A physical mock-up of a finished work item for the parties to agree on quality and appearance before full-scale construction.

vi: Thí nghiệm chuyên ngành xây dựng
dn: Measurement activities to determine the properties of soil, materials, the construction environment, products, parts of a work or the work itself according to a specified procedure. Per Clause 5, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

Activities to inspect and assess the quality or the cause of damage and the technical parameters of materials, components, products, parts or the work through survey, monitoring and testing. Per Clause 8, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

Construction inspection activities and the assessment of compliance with construction investment law, organized by the competent state management agency. Per Clause 9, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

Activities to monitor, measure and record changes in geometry, deformation, displacement and other technical parameters of the work and surrounding environment over time. Per Clause 6, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

Measurement activities to determine the position, shape and dimensions of terrain and works for construction, quality management, warranty, maintenance, operation and incident handling. Per Clause 7, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Giám sát thi công xây dựng
dn: Regular, systematic monitoring and inspection of the construction process to ensure compliance with the design, technical specifications, regulations, standards and the contract.

The title of an individual assigned by the supervision organization to manage and direct construction supervision activities for a specific work or bid package. Per Clause 5, Article 3 Decree 212/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Danh sách tồn tại cần khắc phục
dn: A list of minor defects and unfinished items recorded during pre-acceptance or pre-handover inspection that the contractor must complete.

vi: Chạy thử và nghiệm thu vận hành
dn: Testing and adjusting equipment and technical systems to confirm they operate as designed before handover.
Transferring the accepted, completed work, together with its records and documents, to the investor or the unit managing and using it.

vi: Biên bản nghiệm thu hoàn thành, chứng nhận tiếp nhận
dn: A document confirming that the work or work item has been completed and accepted for use; usually the milestone from which the warranty period begins.

vi: Nhật ký thi công xây dựng
dn: A daily log of construction progress, labor, equipment, weather, incidents and the parties' comments at the site.

vi: Kiểm tra độc lập (bên thứ ba)
dn: Hiring an independent party to inspect, test and assess so as to obtain objective results on quality.

vi: An toàn, sức khỏe và môi trường
dn: A management system to prevent accidents, occupational diseases and adverse environmental impacts during construction.

vi: An toàn trong thi công xây dựng công trình
dn: Measures to prevent and counter the effects of dangerous and harmful factors so as not to cause injury, death or health impairment to people, and to prevent incidents during construction. Per Clause 17, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Biện pháp bảo đảm an toàn trong thi công
dn: A set of measures (Appendix III of Decree 207/2026) to ensure occupational safety and health, environmental protection, fire prevention and fighting, and community safety. Per Clause 18, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Vùng nguy hiểm trong thi công
dn: The boundary of areas in and around the site where dangerous factors may arise and cause damage to people, works or property. Per Clause 30, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.

vi: Sự cố công trình xây dựng
dn: Damage exceeding the permitted safety limits that puts the work or temporary construction structures at risk of collapse, or has caused partial or total collapse. Per Clause 29, Article 3 Construction Law 2025.

vi: Phân tích an toàn công việc
dn: Breaking a task into steps, identifying the hazards at each step and setting out control measures.

vi: Đánh giá rủi ro an toàn
dn: Identifying hazards and assessing their likelihood and consequences in order to decide on appropriate control measures.
A document authorizing hazardous work (work at height, hot work, confined spaces, electrical work, etc.) after safety conditions have been checked.
A short talk before work starts to remind workers of the hazards and safety measures for the day's tasks.

vi: Phương tiện bảo vệ cá nhân
dn: Helmets, shoes, safety harnesses, glasses, gloves, protective clothing, etc. that workers must use when working.
Welding, cutting, grinding or other work that produces sparks or heat with a risk of fire, to be controlled through a work permit.
Work performed at a location with a risk of falling from height, which must have working platforms, guardrails, nets or suitable safety harnesses.
An event that could have led to an accident but caused no injury or damage; it should be reported so lessons can be learned.

vi: Cô lập năng lượng, treo biển cảnh báo
dn: A procedure to isolate and lock out energy sources and hang warning tags before repairing equipment to prevent unexpected start-up.

vi: Kế hoạch quản lý môi trường
dn: Measures to control dust, noise, wastewater, waste and impacts on the area around the site.

vi: Vệ sinh, sắp xếp công trường
dn: Keeping the site tidy and clean with clear walkways to reduce the risk of accidents, fire and explosion.

vi: Phương án ứng cứu khẩn cấp
dn: A plan for handling fires, explosions, accidents and incidents: assignment of roles, communication, first aid and evacuation.
The person assigned to monitor, inspect and guide occupational safety and environmental hygiene at the site.
The time plan for the whole project, showing the stages, main work items and key milestones.
A chart showing tasks as horizontal bars along a timeline, showing start and end times and overlaps between tasks.
A point in time marking the completion of an important event, with no duration; used for control and payment.
The longest chain of tasks that determines the project completion time; a delay to any task on the critical path delays the whole project.
A technique for preparing and analyzing schedules based on the predecessor-successor relationships of tasks to find the critical path and float.
The length of time a task can be delayed without delaying subsequent tasks or the project completion date.

vi: Tiến độ cuốn chiếu ngắn hạn
dn: A detailed plan for the next 2-6 weeks, updated frequently to coordinate labor, materials and equipment on site.
The waiting time (lag) or overlap (lead) between two dependent tasks.

vi: Công việc trước / công việc sau
dn: The dependency relationship between tasks: the successor task can start or finish only when the predecessor meets a condition.
Determining the cause, responsibility and impact of delays on the completion time, as the basis for granting extensions or handling breaches.
Measures to add labor, equipment and shifts to shorten construction time.
A cumulative chart of quantities or value over time, used to compare plan and actual.

vi: Biểu đồ nhân lực, tài nguyên
dn: A chart of the number of workers and equipment over time, helping to level resources.
Overlapping stages or tasks that would normally be done in sequence in order to shorten the duration, accepting higher risk.
The period from commencement to completion of construction of the work under the contract.

vi: Thời gian thực hiện dự án
dn: The period specified in the project approval decision, counted from the investment decision to completion and handover of the works for use. Per Clause 6, Article 3 Decree 217/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Mô hình thông tin công trình
dn: A method of creating and using a 3D digital model containing information on the geometry, materials, quantities and equipment of a work throughout its life cycle.
A platform for storing, sharing and managing project information centrally, with access control and version management.

vi: Mức độ phát triển thông tin
dn: The level of detail and reliability of information in each BIM model element at each stage.
Using software to detect clashes between disciplines (structure, architecture, MEP) in the model before construction.

vi: Yêu cầu thông tin của chủ đầu tư
dn: A document stating the requirements for information and BIM models that the contractor or consultant must provide.
A plan describing how the parties organize, coordinate and exchange BIM models and data in the project.
A BIM model with the added dimensions of time (4D - schedule) and cost (5D - quantities, cost estimate).
An open data format used to exchange BIM models between different software.
A digital model updated with actual operational data, used to monitor, analyze and manage the work.
Survey data of existing conditions captured by laser scanners, used to build an as-is model or check construction deviations.
A model combined from separate discipline models for coordination and clash checking.

vi: Cơ sở dữ liệu xây dựng
dn: A digital data system on construction activities, the capability of organizations and individuals, works, etc., serving management and public disclosure of information as prescribed.

vi: Bảo trì công trình xây dựng
dn: The set of activities to ensure and maintain the normal, safe functioning of a work as designed during its operation and use. Per Clause 10, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Quy trình bảo trì công trình
dn: A document specifying the sequence, content and instructions for carrying out maintenance of the work. Per Clause 11, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Thời hạn sử dụng theo thiết kế
dn: The period for which the work is expected to be used, meeting the safety and functional requirements of the design. Per Clause 12, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Thời hạn sử dụng thực tế
dn: The period for which the work is actually used, meeting safety and functional requirements. Per Clause 13, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Bảo hành công trình xây dựng
dn: The contractor's commitment to be responsible for remedying and repairing, within a specified period, defects and deficiencies that may arise during the operation and use of the work. Per Clause 14, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Thời hạn thông báo sai sót (bảo hành)
dn: The period after taking over the work during which the investor may notify defects for the contractor to repair (a FIDIC term).
An individual or organization with ownership of the work under the law. Per Clause 15, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Chủ quản lý, sử dụng công trình
dn: The owner directly managing and using the work, or an organization or individual authorized by the owner to manage and use the work. Per Clause 16, Article 2 Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

vi: Quản lý vận hành tòa nhà
dn: Managing, operating and maintaining the technical systems and services of the work during its operation.

vi: Tài liệu hướng dẫn vận hành, bảo trì
